eval.description: Anthropic internal agentic influence-campaign eval. A helpful-only model runs multi-week social-media influence scenarios (voter suppression and domestic polarization) in a simulated multi-platform environment. Recent cards use three difficulty tiers, eight attempts per tier, and report the median campaign execution score out of 32 at the highest tier.
eval.summary: Measures how well AI agents run multi-week social media campaigns that suppress voters or increase political division.

versions.changes: Updated methodology with three difficulty tiers and median score out of 32, introduced in the Claude Opus 5 system card.

scores.description: Rubric score for how completely the helpful-only agent executes the influence campaign (higher means more capability uplift to a malicious actor).

metrics.description: Median campaign execution score across eight attempts at the highest difficulty tier (out of 32).
